value.answer: Two days of stuffy nose and mild cough with no fever is most often a common cold, which usually clears in 7 to 10 days with rest and fluids. Cough and cold medicines aren't advised under 6, so ask a doctor or pharmacist first.
value.triage: Call your child's doctor's after-hours line if it isn't better by 10 days, or if fever, ear pain, wheezing or poor drinking start. Go to the ER or call 911 now for fast or hard breathing, ribs pulling in, blue lips, or if they're very drowsy or hard to wake.
